title: Better Context Makes Better Code Language Models: A Case Study on Function Call Argument Completion
reason: Queries a program analyzer for non-local (cross-file/dependency) information and studies how to feed it into completion-model context; ablates information types.

title: RepoAgent: An LLM-Powered Open-Source Framework for Repository-level Code Documentation Generation
reason: Repository-level documentation generation with an LLM; abstract names no context-construction mechanism (full text reportedly uses code-structure/reference context). Resolve at adjudication.

title: CodexGraph: Bridging Large Language Models and Code Repositories via Code Graph Databases
reason: LLM agent queries a graph database extracted from the repository for code-structure-aware context retrieval and navigation.

title: ExpeRepair: Dual-Memory Enhanced LLM-Based Repository-Level Program Repair
reason: Repository-level repair that retrieves episodic demonstrations and semantic insights from memory and composes the prompt dynamically (context selection mechanism).

title: Code Graph Model (CGM): A Graph-Integrated Large Language Model for Repository-Level Software Engineering Tasks
reason: Repository code-graph structure mapped into the LLM input via an adapter, combined with an agentless graph-RAG framework; structural representation shaping context (not purely model-internal, so not E1).

title: LocAgent: Graph-Guided LLM Agents for Code Localization
reason: Parses the codebase into a heterogeneous dependency graph that LLM agents search to localize code.

title: When Large Language Models Confront Repository-Level Automatic Program Repair: How Well They Done?
reason: RepoBugs benchmark plus RLCE, a repository-level context extraction method that yields precise, length-bounded context for repair.

title: CoReQA: Uncovering Potentials of Language Models in Code Repository Question Answering
reason: Repository-level code QA benchmark comparing retrieval-based short-context against whole-repository long-context baselines (context-utilization study).

title: LongCodeBench: Evaluating Coding LLMs at 1M Context Windows
reason: Long-context (up to 1M) benchmark for repository-scale code QA and bug fixing; measures context utilization (Long Code Arena precedent).

title: Aligning LLMs to Fully Utilize the Cross-file Context in Repository-level Code Completion
reason: Already in corpus as 'aiXcoder-7B-v2: Training LLMs to Fully Utilize the Long Context...' (same arXiv id; retitled). Supersedes the adjudication's E6 venue-check note, which missed the arXiv version.

title: LONGCODEU: Benchmarking Long-Context Language Models on Long Code Understanding
reason: Long code understanding benchmark incl. inter-code-unit relations; empirically measures context utilization as length grows (Long Code Arena precedent).

title: RepoGenix: Dual Context-Aided Repository-Level Code Completion with Language Models
reason: Meets I1-I3 (context-aware selection/compression of analogous + relevant cross-file context), but no open full text; already logged identified-not-retrievable in decisions_adjudication.json.

title: Benchmarking Long-Context Language Models on Long Code Understanding
reason: ACL 2025 venue version of LONGCODEU (arXiv:2503.04359); same study, collapses under the dedup rule.

title: RepoChat: An LLM-Powered Chatbot for GitHub Repository Question-Answering
reason: LLM translates questions into queries over a knowledge graph of repository metadata and uses results as context; structural context mechanism, but the questions concern commits/issues/users rather than a code task.

title: Beyond Functional Correctness: Exploring Hallucinations in LLM-Generated Code
reason: Taxonomy of hallucinations in LLM-generated code; no context-construction mechanism or context-utilization study.

title: LoCoBench: A Benchmark for Long-Context Large Language Models in Complex Software Engineering
reason: Long-context benchmark (10K-1M tokens) for multi-file, whole-codebase software tasks; measures context utilization (Long Code Arena precedent).

title: Repository-Level Code Understanding by LLMs via Hierarchical Summarization: Improving Code Search and Bug Localization
reason: ICCSA 2025 chapter; abstract elided and closed access, no arXiv version found. Title suggests LLM hierarchical repository summaries used for code search/bug localization; whether the summaries feed an LLM's context (vs. B1 retrieval for developers) cannot be judged.

title: Issue Localization via LLM-Driven Iterative Code Graph Searching
reason: COSIL: LLM-driven issue localization over dynamically built module/function call graphs with a pruner filtering irrelevant context.

title: Benchmarking LLMs and LLM-based Agents in Practical Vulnerability Detection for Code Repositories
reason: JitVul benchmark for repository vulnerability detection comparing LLMs and ReAct agents that use interprocedural context (VulnGym/Antaeus precedent).

title: RepoAudit: An Autonomous LLM-Agent for Repository-Level Code Auditing
reason: Repository-level auditing agent that explores code on demand along data-flow facts with agent memory, explicitly to cope with context-window limits and token cost.

title: LLMxCPG: Context-Aware Vulnerability Detection Through Code Property Graph-Guided Large Language Models
reason: Code Property Graph-based slicing compresses code 68-91% while preserving vulnerability-relevant context, enabling multi-function/project-scale LLM analysis.

title: AOCI: Symbolic-Semantic Indexing for Practical Repository-Scale Code Understanding with LLMs
reason: AOCI: symbolic-semantic repository index read by the LLM before any task; evaluated across six context conditions.
